title: Grateful Dead Live at The Music Box on 1969-04-15
lineage: Aiwa hand-held microphone > Master Reel (Aiwa 5 inch reel-to-reel) > Alesis Masterlink 9600 > Hard Drive > CD > EAC > Samplitude Professional v7.02 > shntool > FLAC16

ai_review.summary: Hand‑held audience tape captures an electrifying 1969 show with monster Dark Star and a half‑hour Turn On Your Lovelight, surprisingly clear despite crowd chatter.
ai_review.review: The performance is lauded for its raw energy – standout moments include a soaring Dark Star, a marathon Turn On Your Lovelight, and a thunderous The Other One – with seamless segues that keep the momentum high. Although the recording is an audience (AUD) capture using a hand‑held mic, reviewers note it is remarkably listenable, only marred by occasional chatter and limited low‑end fidelity.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews are 4–5 stars, praising the show’s energy and song quality; recording imperfections are noted but considered minor given the source.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Hand‑held mic captures crowd ambience and occasional chatter (notably a talking female during Dark Star). Sound is clear for an AUD tape, with some low‑end muddiness but overall listenable.

standout_songs: Sitting on Top of the World
show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth, high‑energy segues (especially China Cat into the rest of the set) keep the momentum; transitions are praised as priceless treasures.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals and guitar described as great; his axe sounds front‑and‑center with perfect tone.
band_member_comments.Phil: Called a "monster" and praised for powerful bass playing.
band_member_comments.Bob: One reviewer dismissively says "Bob's who cares," otherwise not highlighted.
